title: Phase F: Predictive Transfer & BKM Generalization to Tabular Data
user_cohort: COHORT-CANARY-D4 (N=30 independent operators, zero overlap with cohorts A, B, C)
goal: Test whether BKM-CANARY-001 enables calibrated, accurate predictive transfer into an adjacent unverified domain (Tabular CSV Uploader) while maintaining zero PII/formula leakage and proving anti-dogmatic negative transfer rejection on streaming binary protocols.
